name: Strategy 101 — Understanding Pillars & Cascade
description: Introductory session on the 5 strategic pillars, OKR cascade per ENH-145, and how individual contributions ladder up to bank strategy. Suitable for all staff.

name: Strategic Initiative Management
description: Deep-dive on ENH-144 portfolio optimization, ENH-146 gap analysis, and ENH-147 corrective action generation. Targeted at managers and initiative owners.

name: STO Toolkit Masterclass
description: Full walkthrough of the Strategy Transformation Office toolkit (ENH-154): portfolio management, risk register, review cycles, analytics, and ROI attribution (ENH-155).

name: Strategy Simulation Workshop
description: Hands-on workshop using ENH-151 simulator to test resource reallocation scenarios and what-if modeling. Bring your scenarios.
